identitySignals: FMCSA carrier record (via carrierchk.com) lists legal name ACCELAR INC with DBA Pronto Corporation, located in San Jose, CA, matching the agenda's 'Accelar, Inc. dba Pronto Corporation / Pronto Journeys' and 'San Jose, CA'
prontojourneys.com redirects to ipronto.com, whose footer names Pronto Corporation and whose phone 650-249-7415 matches the phone on the Accelar Inc carrier record

ipronto.com has a page stating Pronto has been a district-wide transportation partner to Oakland Unified School District (OUSD) since 2022, matching the agenda's school pupil activity bus transportation agreement
research.notes: Website prontojourneys.com redirects to ipronto.com. Legal name, address and DOT/MC numbers come from a third-party mirror of FMCSA carrier data; CA Secretary of State, EIN and SAM UEI were not checked or found, so those are null. The address was not shown on ipronto.com.

profile.address: 84 W Santa Clara St Suite 700, San Jose, CA 95113
profile.summary: Pronto Corporation, a business name of Accelar Inc, is a transportation company based in San Jose, California. Through its Pronto Journeys platform it arranges group and student transportation, such as school field trips, athletics trips and charters, using shuttles, buses and motorcoaches.

sources.title: Oakland Unified School District and Pronto

review.notes: The FMCSA mirror lists ACCELAR INC dba Pronto Corporation in San Jose with the same phone as ipronto.com, prontojourneys.com 301-redirects to ipronto.com, and ipronto.com/district/oakland-usd states Pronto has been OUSD's district-wide transportation partner since 2022. Address, phone, email, website and the neutral summary are all supported by the cited sources.
